The '~1.1 h' is FF-3E's projection (docs/handoffs/ff-poc-closeout-2026-07.md SS6), built as 90 s/yr x 25 yr = 0.62 h flat-median lower bound, x a ~1.76x super-linear uplift. NYISO'S HONEST RANGE IS ~0.62 h (flat-median) TO ~1.1 h (projection) - AND THE TWO INFERENCE ROUTES CONVERGE HERE, unlike at PJM/MISO: NYISO's projection carries a ~1.76x uplift essentially identical to NEISO's ~1.75x, so applying NEISO's measured 1.73x conservatism as a factor also gives ~0.63 h. NYISO is the ISO to which the NEISO refutation transfers BEST (light, pairable, ~4.2 GB projected, comparable per-year cost), so ~0.62-0.65 h is the better central reading than 1.1 h - still an INFERENCE, not an NYISO measurement, and this field is not a schedulability grant. Pairable, unchanged. AGAINST D46 SS9 ITEM 3: the 7-10x factor it routes is a SPAN ARTIFACT (5-year totals compared against 25-year projections; 5x span x ~1.7x uplift), the span-corrected factor is ~1.7x, and the suggested reading of ~45-90 min is NOT SUPPORTED by any measurement and is refused. Its 2026/2027 misses (36 MW / 51 MW, the smallest in the program) closed on 2026-08-25 when NYISO's published external-capacity accreditation was sourced and added to ADEQUACY_EXTERNAL_TIE_FIRM_MW on the FF-2B construction -- 3,168.5 MW ICAP x (1 - 0.1321) = 2,749.9 MW UCAP, 2026 Gold Book Table V-1 with the published NYCA ICAP->UCAP factor. NYISO's close is a second, INDEPENDENT route to the same family (external capacity omitted from the ledger) and the cross-ISO check for it is FINDING-capx-d2b-i7-ledger-2026-08-25.md §6: MISO's equivalent intake is lane S-2, NEISO's hydro accreditation is lane S-4.
